notes.title: 24th of September 2025, Changelog for full and demo builds:
notes.notes: [p]CHANGES, ADDITIONS & BUGFIXES[/p][list][*][p]Added a system that will start a voting, whether or not to start a boss fight once a players enters the boss area. if everyone accepts, all players are teleported to the bossroom, if not, they stay where they were and the fight is canceled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Boss Sharr Ishkun's thrown up egg: it sometimes left it's toxic puddle in mid air instead of on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a variation for Boss Sharr Ishkun's thrown up egg skill: sometimes the egg won't leave a toxic puddle on the ground but actually spawn pest crows that attack you.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players reported issues when leaving a coop run that some achievements were not properly unlocked or characters being gone - to prevent this, we now made sure that the clients leave first and in the end the server wraps up the session and leaves last.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Respawn Device" name to "Respawn Shrine" since it's referenced as a shrine in game text.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual variations for rings, necklaces and capes ( no ai designs, but modelled and rendered as with all the other icons).[/p][/*][*][p]We had a single sound for various, mostly "problematic" situations, for example:[/p][list][*][p]the inventory is full and and the player tries to pick something up[/p][/*][*][p]player tries to perform a skill without having enough mana [/p][/*][*][p]not having the minimum amount of stamina when trying to block, sprint... [/p][/*][*][p]evading an attack and thus fully preventing any damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]So for all these cases we have added individual sounds now, hopefully enabling you to learn what's going on without having to check your inventory or mana/stamina bar etc..[/p][list][*][p]Added sounds for interacting with level transition actors (for example the door in the canyon that leads to the temple or the portals that open up after slaying a boss).[/p][/*][*][p]There was a nasty bug that would prevent you from using any skills after you evaded and performed an attack at the same time. the only way to reset this was to get stunned, but the bug is fixed now.[/p][/*][*][p]Another nasty bug with desert spiders: when you killed them while they were still spawning, they were sometimes able to land another attack on you while still being invisible/underground.[/p][/*][*][p]Clients were not able to leave the dungeon on their own, this has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Being stunned while attacking would sometimes not show the stunned pose on your player but rather the last attack animation. This has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam friend invite and steam join a friend's game fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Mystic, deadly, Varthos
notes.notes:

[/p][p]Follow us, wishlist now, and get ready for the demo debuting during Steam’s upcoming Next Fest.[/p][p][/p][p][b]4k/UHD[/b] (3840 * 2160 px),[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/032fda75bc9e36bd7c28b9b0a88446084c3f3077.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/f17813406b05b4eb11fd70018835565faf4a0ccd.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][b]2k/WQHD[/b] (2560 * 1440 px) and[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/f8b4e5af05e41b7d6147065bd94191f5b1a31c1b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/99d24dd35e9d59a3292974c40ff619d185be1e4b.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][b]Full HD[/b] (1920 * 1080 px)[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/9de386ea239d78b2533952b0730561f2d1536994.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/f6a1170787c149911346318f179f62869bb49700.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 7th of August 2025, Changelog for full and demo builds:
notes.notes: [p][/p][list][*][p]The hitpoints of Bosses are partially scaled down based on the amount of teammembers (only bosses, neither mini-bosses nor ordinary monsters),[/p][list][*][p]3 players = boss has full hp[/p][/*][*][p]2 players = boss full hp divided by 1.75[/p][/*][*][p]1 player = boss full hp divided by 2.5 [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The bottom bar (permanent user interface on the bottom of the screen with skillslots, health- & manabar) got a redesign. While we are happy with the current look, for future versions we plan to add a scaling option to the settings menu, so you can scale it down in steps to maybe 75% or 50%. Let us know what you think!,[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]Since a few players have missed the buttons for their unlocked additional inventory tabs, we made them more obvious in both the player inventory as well as the stash. It wasn't buggy loot that vanished you guys, it simply went into the new inventory space you unlocked and you missed the button ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515685/617164f60aed07e89885fcae0179d83a966bbe91.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]While most of the icons for Buffs & DeBuffs hopefully were pretty self explanatory, we now made it possible for you to hover them for tooltips explaining the effect and its source. Please let us know if we missed out on certain effects or if you need more info.,[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]There was an issue with certain pieces of geometry not blending out when they should - this has been fixed. Example: certain columns not blending out when you went behind them, such as the bridge pieces towards the stash in the Canyon.,[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][list][*][p]We accidently made the startup/intro movies not skippable in the last release - now you can smash that ESC button againːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 28th of July 2025, Changelog for full and demo builds
notes.notes: [p][b]28th of July 2025, Changelog for full and demo builds:  [/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue regarding the loading screen: in some cases it was deactivated too early when loading a map, which lead to players seeing a blue sky for some time while the dungeon was randomized and built in the background. We hope this is fixed now.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation for when successfully evading an attack[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced stamina drain from sprinting by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]So far 1 handed weapons were mostly used for dual wielding (albeit risky, this offers the highest DPM potential). Now we DRASTICALLY changed the way that shields work to make using them more attractive and look forward to hearing your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]The "Block Damage Reduction" stat on shields was removed, from now on blocking with a shield blocks 100% of damage, regardless of the type (physical, fire, ...). [/p][/*][*][p]A new stat was introduced on shields called "Block Stamina Cost" with the value randomly rolled upon the item dropping [/p][/*][*][p]So while the shield will block 100% of damage of each hit, this will cost a certain amount of stamina every time; if you don't have enough stamina, you stop blocking and can't do so anymore until you regenerated to the requirement stamina value of the shield you are holding [/p][/*][*][p]Remember you have to actively block by pressing and holding the left CTRL key (default binding) and turn towards the source of damage to prevent damage [/p][/*][*][p]Stamina regeneration is disabled while you are blocking (while holding the key) [/p][/*][*][p]You can even block all damage of a boss attack, but that will drain all your stamina and stun you briefly [/p][/*][*][p]Let us know what you think - is the stun after being attacked by a boss too much, shall we only drain all stamina? We were thinking about introducing a modifier for stamina drain from monster attacks, to ensure that for example spider attacks would drain less mana than the ones from a larger/tougher monster, but that would again weaken the shield and make the system less clear. So we'd like you to test this iteration first.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Since around 60% of the playtesters asked for this, we added an option to the settings menu under the "general" tab:[/p][list][*][p]When dashing or jump rolling, you can now choose between doing so towards where your cursor is (this is how it used to be so far) or instead move towards where you are running (new) [/p][/*][*][p]Example: when running sideways to the right with the cursor kept at a certain distance in front of where your character is looking, the old system would make you dash/jump forward towards the cursor. The new system will instead make you dash/jump towards the direction you are running (to the right in this case). Same would be the case for when running backwards, etc. [/p][/*][*][p]If you are standing still, you will always dash/jump forward as your character keeps orienting to your cursor. [/p][/*][*][p]We also ensured that the distance for dashes and jumps is not influenced by your character running or sprinting anymore, making it easier to for example pinpoint an explosive dash and make it trigger right where the monsters are standing. You will learn and remember that distance in no time. [/p][/*][*][p]So, a lot of people have asked for this, please test it and let us know how it feels! The final argument that made us move this topic up in priority was the idea of being in a bossfight with your cursor on the boss to attack and then having to quickly evade an attack. With the old system you have to move your cursor towards a desired position first, while with the new system you can almost instantly dash/jump side- and backwards without loosing focus. [/p][/*][*][p]While at it, we also changed the jumproll animation to make it more compact and believable. Instead of the character stretching all limps to full extend, it's now less an artistic jump and more of a military/ninja type of roll.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Closed Demo including Bossfight!
notes.notes: [list][*][p]exploit to create infinite potions in the character creation has been fixed: starting potions given to a new character can't be moved to the stash anymore until you have started a game[/p][/*][*][p]another exploit that allowed you to equip weapons you did not have the requirements for when dual wielding has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]removed chat widget and ready button from post lobby screen(map selection) when playing offline/solo as some playtesters seemed to find it disturbing[/p][/*][*][p]removed party and guild tabs from chat window for now[/p][/*][*][p]added key binding options for highlighting loot, character preview window, perks & attributes window, zooming in, zooming out, zoom reset, chat window[/p][/*][*][p]moved stamina bar above healthbar, moved exp bar above mana bar[/p][/*][/list][p]ATTENTION [/p][list][*][p]based on your feedback, we added a sneak peak of the desert temple to the demo, including the first boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]please keep in mind that entering a new map makes all monsters and loot drops scale to your level, so don't be surprised if it's going to be tough - but that also means that almost every item you find is going to be better than what you have[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 11th of July 2025, Changelog
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Another fix / safety measure for inventory logic,[/p][/*][*][p]All game versions (internal, demo, release) now have their own save games and can't be exchanged with each other,[/p][/*][*][p]Default audio levels (volumes) set to:,[/p][list][*][p] MASTER to be 50%[/p][/*][*][p]MUSIC to be 50%[/p][/*][*][p]EFFECTS to be 75%[/p][/*][*][p]AMBIENCE to be 75% [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bonus for magic find (from traits and items), which improves the chance to get loot of a higher quality, will now take the group average value for the calculations, whereas,[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus for XP gain (from traits and items) only counts for your own character. that being said, remember that XP is shared, but split. Example: as a solo player, a Desert Spider gives 3 XP points. When playing as a duo, every players receives 1,5 XP points instead, regardless how fart apart they are and who did the killing blow. yet again, xp gain bonus is based in these base XP points.,[/p][/*][*][p]From now on level up VFX are only shown for your own character as it was quite disturbing when playing with several players and they all leveled up at the same time while being in combat,[/p][/*][*][p]There was an issue with stacking potions when interacting with your stash while being in a dungeon, this has been resolved[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Closed Demo/Beta Release & Changelog
notes.notes:
[p]We released a closed demo/beta build! You can get a key to test it on /r/IndieGames or rather their Discord as they are doing a giveaway early next week (around 7th of July). Alternatively you can join our Discord and see if we have one spare. Keep in mind, HttT is not even in early access, this is an early internal version: no localization (english only), solely running on Windows.[b]

30th of June 2025, Changelog for full and demo builds:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]New Playerskill: Added short range melee stun skill "headbutt". It's supposed to be single target and improve melee fighters survivability when fighting at the very front line,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a rare jump attack for desert spiders,[/p][/*][*][p]In main menu, hints should not overlay the welcome window anymore,[/p][/*][*][p]Added all new "out of combat regen": your characters stamina and mana regeneration will now increase by 200% when "out of combat". Conditions:[/p][list][*][p]You possessed/took control of your character at least 20s ago [/p][/*][*][p]You did not receive damage for 10s [/p][/*][*][p]You did not deal damage for 10s[/p][/*][*][p]Your character has not been a target of a monster for 10s [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Out of combat status should end when one of the above conditions change,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hint for when leaving a run for the first time,[/p][/*][*][p]Monster aggro/alerted sounds should not trigger in combat as often as before,[/p][/*][*][p]Players can't run through lootable chests anymore,[/p][/*][*][p]Reintroduced map specific ambient sounds (as for the canyon things like, crickets, lion roars, birds...),[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap is now opened by default after loading a map. Remember you can open a big overview by holding the TAB key.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a little variation to a weapon's attack power values,[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the cost for the various level up traits (spellbook in character creation),[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base armor stat for all shields,[/p][/*][*][p]Stashes found in game now have a description when opening them,[/p][/*][*][p]There was a potential issue when equipping bows and quivers that ultimately led to the inventory logic getting messed up, allowing you to have a 2 handed staff and a shield equipped at the same time, or, while dual wielding 2 maces, it would still show a bow in either your hand or between your character's legs. We hopefully fixed all of those edge cases by now - if not, please let us know.[/p][/*][/list][p]We look forward to talking to you on our Discord anytime :)[/p]
